mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals monetary tightening that raises equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises above 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in labor market strength (PAYEMS) and housing demand (HOUST) signals robust economic expansion that accelerates corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both PAYEMS and HOUST rise, or Rank IC for the interaction term over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of strong GDP growth (GDPC1 annualized > 2.5%), rising housing starts (HOUST) signal accelerating consumer demand and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.5% and HOUST rises, or Rank IC for HOUST in strong GDP growth periods is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5% reflects weak labor market conditions that suppress consumer spending and corporate profit growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5% signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer confidence and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE falls below 5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation expectations (CPIAUCSL) and declining industrial production (INDPRO) signals stagflationary risk that increases equity risk premiums, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises and INDPRO falls, or Rank IC for the interaction term over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high industrial production growth (INDPRO annualized > 2.0%), sustained manufacturing output growth signals strong corporate capital expenditure and earnings momentum, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 2.0%, or Rank IC for INDPRO in high growth periods is below 0.03.
